seeding: no sampling seed is exposed by the Claude CLI; stability is measured by repeated independent runs

cases.claim: For code reviews, the user prefers concise feedback that includes one concrete test result.
The user wants the assistant to run the relevant tests and explain important tradeoffs before finishing coding tasks.
The user dislikes hard-coded environment values and prefers that they be made configurable.
The user prefers detailed review feedback rather than concise summaries.
For the Orion project only, the user wants the public API kept backward compatible, even when a breaking redesign would be cleaner.
When debugging, the user wants to see the failing reproduction first, then the smallest fix, then the verification result.
The user's goal this quarter is to reduce the build pipeline time to below five minutes.
The user maintains the Rust client and can review Rust lifetime and ownership changes themself.
The user prefers summaries formatted as bullet lists rather than long paragraphs.
The user wants commit messages to explain why a change was made, not just what changed.
The user's goal for the next month is to migrate their team's billing service off the legacy queue.
In the Orion project, the user wants to be asked first before any new runtime dependencies are added.
The user is the on-call owner for their team's Postgres clusters and can handle replication failovers themself.
When a refactor is proposed, the user wants the list of files that would be touched shown before any changes are made.
The user prefers quiet logs that show errors only, replacing an earlier preference for verbose logs.
The user is interested in property-based testing and wants to learn more about it.

limitations: Synthetic corpus is reproducible but is not a sample of real users.
Term/category labels are explicit adjudication rules; extraction confidence is not calibrated to factual truth.
Sensitive-inference review remains protected by deterministic tests; this corpus does not evaluate sensitive-attribute classification.
